schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Electron-microprobe mapping, for the pallasites only — "Quantitative analysis, mixed WDS/EDS element mapping, and characterization of the mineral phases from NWA 1911 and Zinder were performed" on the Bruker instrument, producing Si, Al, Cr, Fe, Mg, Ca, Na, P and Ni maps "along with backscattered electron (BSE) maps" at 6 μm per pixel (pp.5–6); for the irons the paper states only that the rasters were "taken on polished surfaces" (p.5)
